description: Deterministic, fail-closed local matcher for the structured-output boundary-validation direction. A model never sees this text. Anything outside the frozen lexicon fails closed (no direction leg).
note_ignore_quoted: Drop spans inside single/double quotes or backticks before matching; quoted text is usually example output, not an instruction.

question_markers.note: Classify a sentence as a question BEFORE stripping its terminal delimiter (order matters).

match_rule.step_2: Split into sentences on sentence_boundary_chars, but classify each sentence as a question FIRST (terminal '?' or leading interrogative) before discarding delimiters.
match_rule.step_3: A sentence is a POSITIVE DIRECTION iff it contains >=1 control_term AND >=1 boundary_term (same sentence) AND (>=1 directive_term OR an imperative_pattern match) AND is NOT a question AND has NO negation_marker.
match_rule.step_4: Accept if >=1 positive-direction sentence exists AND no sentence carries a conflicting negation/question signal about the same control. Store ALL matched excerpts (or their combined bounded span) with their per-record byte hashes.
match_rule.step_5: Otherwise -> NO direction leg. Ambiguity always fails closed.

pass: validate model output against the schema and reject invalid results before writing to the database
validate the output before the database write. reject invalid values before persisting.

fail.reason: no control term and no boundary term

fail.text: schema validation exists before the database write.
fail.reason: no directive term / not imperative (incidental statement)
